research.topic: Psychologist vs Psychiatrist vs Counsellor: Who to See for What
research.hook: The harsh truth: 70 % of students waste weeks looking for the wrong mental‑health professional. Here’s the three mistakes you’re probably making and how to fix them in 60 seconds.
research.tip: Create a Help‑Match Sheet: write your main symptom, match it to the appropriate professional, and schedule a brief 15‑minute intake call.
